info.name: Tigun the Guard at the Palace

descriptions.notStarted: The palace of #m260000000# boasts a tight security, and doesn't let strangers in, but I really want to see what it's like inside... I should ask the head of the security at the palace, #b#p2101004##k, for help.
descriptions.inProgress: #p2101004# told me flat out he can't let me in the palace... unless I show my allegiance towards Sultan by paying some mesos, then he'll give me a pass to the palace. ...#b2,000 mesos#k isn't much, but I feel like I'm just buying him off.
descriptions.completed: After I paid #p2101004# 2,000 mesos, I received the pass to the palace. Even though I feel like I got ripped off, oh well... at least I can enter the palace now.
